review.body: { fn atom (value : & str) -> bool { ! value . is_empty () && value . len () <= 255 && value . as_bytes () . first () . is_some_and (| byte | byte . is_ascii_lowercase () || byte . is_ascii_digit ()) && value . as_bytes () . last () . is_some_and (| byte | byte . is_ascii_lowercase () || byte . is_ascii_digit ()) && value . bytes () . all (| byte | byte . is_ascii_lowercase () || byte . is_ascii_digit () || byte == b'-') } if self . namespace . is_empty () || self . namespace . len () > 255 || self . namespace . split ('.') . count () < 2 || ! self . namespace . split ('.') . all (atom) || ! atom (& self . name) { return Err (CaseError :: Field) ; } Ok (()) }
review.item_premise: Typed component declarations and validations read bounded public descriptor fields and return closed structural causes. They neither acquire a private value nor decide deployment authority.
